info.description:
### Welcome to Postman! This is your first collection. 

Collections are your starting point for building and testing APIs. You can use this one to:

• Group related requests
• Test your API in real-world scenarios
• Document and share your requests

Update the name and overview whenever you’re ready to make it yours.

[Learn more about Postman Collections.](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/collections-overview/)

exec: //Parse JSON response to allow Postman to read it
var jsonData = pm.response.json();
//Check and Verify HTTP status code
pm.test("Status code is 200", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
//Check and Verify values of first product
pm.test("Check that first product ID is 1", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[0].Id).to.equal(1); });
pm.test("Check that first product Name is Tomato", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[0].Name).to.equal("Tomato"); });
pm.test("Check that first product Category is Fruit", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[0].Category).to.equal("Fruit"); });
pm.test("Check that first product Price is 5", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[0].Price).to.equal(5); });
//Check and Verify values of second product
pm.test("Check that second product ID is 2", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[1].Id).to.equal(2); });
pm.test("Check that second product Name is Wolf", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[1].Name).to.equal("Wolf"); });
pm.test("Check that second product Category is Spice", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[1].Category).to.equal("Spice"); });
pm.test("Check that second product Price is 86", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[1].Price).to.equal(86); });
//Check and Verify values of third product
pm.test("Check that third product ID is 3", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[2].Id).to.equal(3); });
pm.test("Check that third product Name is Humvee", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[2].Name).to.equal("Humvee"); });
pm.test("Check that third product Category is Car", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[2].Category).to.equal("Car"); });
pm.test("Check that third product Price is 86.86", () => { pm.expect(jsonData[2].Price).to.equal(86.86); });
